verdict.summary: The round-4 approval remains supported. The record now consistently distinguishes a fully chain-bound idempotence key from the scoped-down outcome-projection variant, limits the latter to a lower-bound denominator, and avoids claiming that unpublished alias preimages are timeline-verifiable. Its proposed full key covers the semantically relevant retry_decision inputs and derived routing result: ordered evidence membership and reasons, evaluation-time recency partition, ordered resolved chain and remaining chain, arm, and decomposition cause. The record also explicitly preserves the partial-denominator warning if proceed receipts are suppressed. No blocker or major correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in this findings-only design change.
